create_empty_bonds_table: create an empty Bonds table with zero rows using the Bonds.make_empty class method
get_bond_atom_indices: get the from and dest atom indices from a Bonds table given an atom_key array
restrict_bonds_to_atoms: restrict a Bonds table to only bonds where both endpoints exist in a given atom_key subset
export_bonds_to_mmcif_dict: export a Bonds table to an mmCIF-compatible dictionary using atom arrays for chain, residue, and atom identifiers
concatenate_bonds_tables: concatenate multiple Bonds tables with their atom_key arrays, reindexing keys to avoid collisions
